tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You attended a keynote speech by an expert at a university conference. You found the speech impressive and would like to interview the speaker for an article for your class. Write an email to Ms. Johnson.
bullets: Mention what you found impressive about her keynote speech.
Request an interview at her earliest convenience.
Explain the purpose of the interview and how it will be used.
tasks.subject: Request for Interview Following Keynote Speech
